segments.headline: NEW AI GUIDANCE. WHAT CHANGES?
segments.body: FSB: 12 sound practices. PrismBay: 3 executive checks.
segments.spoken: On October fifteenth, the Financial Stability Board published twelve sound practices for responsible AI in financial institutions. They are guidance, not a new law. Here are three executive checks.

segments.headline: CHECK ONE: WHO IS ACCOUNTABLE?
segments.body: Name the decision owner and independent approval point.
segments.spoken: First, identify the accountable owner. Who approves consequential actions? An AI agent's technical access is not business authorization.

segments.headline: CHECK TWO: SHOW THE EVIDENCE
segments.body: Test before launch. Track failures and changing risks.
segments.spoken: Second, demand evidence. Test performance before launch, track failures after launch, and document decisions. A confident answer is not proof of control.

segments.headline: CHECK THREE: PROVE THE STOP
segments.body: Pause actions. Revoke access. Restore the process.
segments.spoken: Third, test intervention. Can your team pause the workflow, revoke access, and recover when a vendor or agent fails?

segments.headline: THE TEN-MINUTE BOARD TEST
segments.spoken: Pick one real AI workflow. Find its named owner, performance record, and tested stop procedure. Missing answers become management actions.

segments.headline: BUILD GOVERNABLE AI SYSTEMS
